description: How far back imagery has already been fetched for one block and one index — the record that stops a backfill paying for the same twelve months twice. It holds no measurement: it is bookkeeping about downloads, and losing it costs money rather than data.

fields.description: One cursor per block per index. A backfill of NDVI says nothing about how far back moisture has been fetched.
fields.label: Index
fields.options:
ndvi
evi
ndre
ndwi
ndmi
savi

fields.description: Set when the archive has been walked as far back as the provider holds. Until then a scheduler keeps reaching backwards from `oldest_fetched`.
fields.label: Backfill Complete

fields.description: The earliest pass already pulled. A backfill resumes BEFORE this, never at it.
fields.label: Oldest Fetched

fields.description: The most recent pass already pulled. A forward sweep resumes AFTER this.
fields.label: Newest Fetched

fields.description: When a pull last touched this cursor, successfully or not — which is how a scheduler that has quietly stopped is noticed.
fields.label: Last Run

fields.description: Why the last attempt failed, kept so a block that stops updating can be explained without re-querying the provider.
fields.label: Last Error

name: Satellite Backfill Cursor
